collection.title: Dacia Duster 2014 to 2016 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Dacia Duster 2014 to 2016 requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" wiper blade on the passenger side, all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Dacia Duster which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
